name: validate-freeze-integrity
description: Prevent any tool call that would modify the verified standards snapshot. Defense-in-depth only; primary control is agent + path instructions.

preToolUse.script: git diff --name-only master-standards-stack/verified-2026-09-17/ 2>/dev/null | grep -q . && echo 'BLOCKED: frozen snapshot modification attempted' >&2 && exit 2 || exit 0
